title: 第四章 道决第五章 一个傻子而已第六章 卖药
lines: 第四章道决
“青涩果成熟的时间只有一个小时，在一个小时内它的果核会变成一颗红色的核仁，那才是我要的灵果。”
“一旦这一次错过了，我就要再等一年，一定要把握好时间。”
叶欢对这颗青涩果非常渴望，虽然这在以前是他完全瞧不上眼的最低级最垃圾的一种灵果了。
但今时不同往日，叶欢不是放不下身份的那种人，这颗青涩果对他太重要了。
叶欢闲来没事，就在青涩果树下打拳，虽然等他迈入炼气初期时，一般的拳脚对他就没什么帮助了，但活动一下筋骨也好。
“这位小朋友好拳法，刚柔并济，颇有气韵，老头我见识的各家拳法也算多了，居然看不出你使的哪家拳法，惭愧。”这时，这个精神健硕的老爷子走了过来。
叶欢的拳本是随便打打，可他前世的修为在这里，不自觉就比划出几分道韵。
叶欢没想到这样都能引起别人的注意，早知道就不打拳了，只好谦虚地说道：“老人家说笑了，我只是随便耍耍花架子，不怎样的。”
老头摇摇头，他是个内行人，看得出叶欢拳绝不是花架子，是有实力的，这个年轻人还蛮谦虚的。于是说道：“诶，年轻人不要太过谦虚，我叫张国仁，年轻的时候也学过几门拳脚功夫，不如我们来切磋一下。”
叶欢现在一心都是青涩果，哪里有心情搭理这个老头，只要能获得青涩果，他不仅实力能提升，他对嗜血丹的压制力也能提高一点。
“你不是我的对手，我不和你切磋，赶紧走吧。”叶欢有些不耐烦地说道，他怕这老头影响他获取青涩果。
老头一愣，他没想到原本谦逊的年轻人突然变得这么嚣张。
你不是我对手？
老头心中一阵不爽，他虽然上年纪了，功夫却没有落下，一般的习武之人还真不是他对手。
“嘿，小后生，你不要看不起我老头子，我给你讲……”
“算了，别说了，来切磋吧。我只有一个要求，输了你就赶紧离开！”
叶欢直接打断了张国仁的讲话，他感觉青涩果成熟的时间越来越近了，没空和他啰嗦了。
张国仁的脸色顿时像是便秘了一般，他从没见过叶欢这么古怪的人，半天他终于憋出了一句：“好。”
年轻人过刚易折，自己给他个教训，也好让他以后谦逊点，这是张国仁的想法。
砰！
叶欢动了，在张国仁话音光落的时候就动了，叶欢拉住他的手往前一带，然后轻轻往后一推。
张国仁只感觉一股大力操控着自己，他就像大海里的一叶孤舟，毫无反抗之力。
还没等张国仁反应过来，他就已经倒飞了出去，好在叶欢巧妙地控制住了力量，张国仁才没有受伤。
“好厉害……”张国仁喃喃道，他虽然有被叶欢偷袭的嫌疑，但他知道叶欢的实力一定远在自己之上。
因为叶欢太快了，而且在叶欢掌控他的时候，他没有一丝还手之力！
“请你离开！”叶欢没有给张国仁讲话的机会。
张国仁从地上爬了起来，他盯着叶欢说道：“你……是不是武者？”
比自己强这么多，一定是一个武者，张国仁兴奋地看着叶欢，没想到自己遇到这么年轻的一个武者。
武者啊，这可是真正的武者，即便是最差的初级武者，那也是超越普通人的存在！
“愿赌服输，请你马上离开！”
叶欢没有给张国仁丝毫好脸色，青涩果成熟在即，要是他再不走，叶欢就只能打着他走了。
张国仁没有再多说话了，转身就走，留下了一句话：“我明天会再来找你的，有要事相商。”
呼！终于走了！
叶欢松了一口气，他才不管这老头有什么事呢，现在唯一重要的，就是提升实力。
作为一个修士，只有实力才能带个叶欢安全感。
“青涩果……成熟了！”叶欢眼中闪过一道精光，他感受到青涩果的灵气变了，十分浓郁，它成熟了！
叶欢纵身一跃，就把5颗青涩果都摘了下来，剥开果皮和果肉，里面火红色的核仁就露了出来，这个东西一年可就这一个时辰才出现。
content_en:
Chapter 4 Dao Jue
"The green fruit only takes one hour to mature. Within one hour, its core will turn into a red kernel. That is the spiritual fruit I want."
"Once I miss it this time, I will have to wait another year, and I must seize the time."
Ye Huan was very eager for this green fruit, even though it was the lowest and most rubbish spiritual fruit that he looked down upon before.
But today is different from the past. Ye Huan is not the kind of person who can't let go of his identity. This green fruit is too important to him.
Ye Huan had nothing to do, so he boxed under the green fruit tree. Although when he entered the early stage of Qi refining, ordinary boxing and kicking would not be of much help to him, but it was good to stretch his muscles and bones.
"This kid has good boxing skills, a combination of hardness and softness, and quite a charm. Old man, I have seen many boxing styles, but I can't tell which boxing style you use. I'm ashamed." At this time, this strong-minded old man came over.
Ye Huan's fists were meant to hit casually, but due to his previous life's cultivation, he unconsciously drew some charm into his gestures.
Ye Huan didn't expect that this would attract other people's attention. If he had known it, he wouldn't have boxed, so he could only say humbly: "The old man is joking, I am just showing off, nothing serious."
The old man shook his head. He was an expert and could see that Ye Huanquan was not just a showman but a real person. This young man was quite humble. So he said: "Hey, young people, don't be too modest. My name is Zhang Guoren. I also learned a few boxing and kicking skills when I was young. Why don't we compete."
Ye Huan is now focused on the Green Fruit, so he is not in the mood to deal with this old man. As long as he can obtain the Green Fruit, not only will his strength be improved, but his ability to suppress the Bloodthirsty Pill will also be improved.
"You are no match for me. I won't compete with you, so hurry up and leave." Ye Huan said impatiently. He was afraid that the old man would affect his ability to obtain the Green Fruit.
The old man was stunned. He didn't expect that the originally humble young man would suddenly become so arrogant.
Are you not my opponent?
The old man felt unhappy for a while. Although he was getting older, his kung fu had not declined. Ordinary martial arts practitioners were really no match for him.
"Hey, young man, don't look down on me, old man, I'll tell you..."
"Forget it, stop talking and let's spar. I only have one request, if you lose, leave immediately!"
Ye Huan directly interrupted Zhang Guoren's speech. He felt that the time for the green fruit to mature was getting closer and closer, and he had no time to talk to him.
Zhang Guoren's face suddenly looked like he was constipated. He had never seen such a weird person as Ye Huan. After a long time, he finally managed to say: "Okay."
It is Zhang Guoren's idea to teach young people a lesson so that they can be more humble in the future.
Bang!
Ye Huan moved. He moved as soon as Zhang Guoren finished speaking. Ye Huan took his hand and pushed it forward, then gently pushed it back.
Zhang Guoren only felt a strong force controlling him. He was like a lonely boat in the sea, with no resistance.
Before Zhang Guoren could react, he had already flown upside down. Fortunately, Ye Huan skillfully controlled the force and Zhang Guoren was not injured.
"It's amazing..." Zhang Guoren murmured. Although he was suspected of being attacked by Ye Huan, he knew that Ye Huan's strength must be far superior to his own.
Because Ye Huan was too fast, and when Ye Huan controlled him, he had no power to fight back!
"Please leave!" Ye Huan did not give Zhang Guoren a chance to speak.
Zhang Guoren got up from the ground, stared at Ye Huan and said, "Are you... a warrior?"
He must be a warrior who is so much stronger than himself. Zhang Guoren looked at Ye Huan excitedly, not expecting to meet such a young warrior.
Warrior, this is a real warrior. Even the worst junior warrior is beyond ordinary people!
"I'm willing to admit defeat, please leave immediately!"
Ye Huan didn't give Zhang Guoren any good looks. The green fruit was about to mature. If he didn't leave, Ye Huan would have no choice but to beat him and leave.
Zhang Guoren didn't say any more, turned around and left, leaving behind a message: "I will come back to you tomorrow to discuss important matters."
Phew! Finally gone!
Ye Huan breathed a sigh of relief. He didn't care what happened to the old man. The only important thing now was to improve his strength.
As a monk, only strength can bring Ye Huan a sense of security.
"The green fruit... is ripe!" A flash of light flashed in Ye Huan's eyes. He felt that the aura of the green fruit had changed. It was very rich. It was ripe!
Ye Huan jumped up and picked out all five green fruits. After peeling off the skin and flesh, the fiery red kernel inside was exposed. This thing only appears at this hour of the year.
